1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Industri

Perkhidmatan Air (Kadar Perkhidmatan Bekalan Air) (Negeri Kedah) 2024.

 (2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2024.

Kadar perkhidmatan bekalan air

2. Kadar perkhidmatan bekalan air bagi negeri Kedah hendaklah sebagaimana yang

ditetapkan dalam Jadual Pertama.

Jenis penggunaan

3. Jenis penggunaan seperti yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama hendaklah

sebagaimana yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual Kedua.

Pembatalan

4. Peraturan-Peraturan Industri Perkhidmatan Air (Kadar Perkhidmatan

Bekalan Air) (Negeri Kedah) 2010 [P.U. (A) 332/2010] dibatalkan.

Kecualian

5. Apa-apa tindakan, notis, arahan atau keputusan yang dilakukan, dibuat atau

diberikan berhubung dengan kadar perkhidmatan bekalan air yang ditetapkan di bawah

Peraturan-Peraturan Industri Perkhidmatan Air (Kadar Perkhidmatan Bekalan Air)

(Negeri Kedah) 2010 sebelum permulaan kuat kuasa Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah

terus sah dan berkuat kuasa sehingga dipinda atau dibatalkan atau sehingga tarikh tamat

tempoh tindakan, notis, arahan atau keputusan itu.

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY ACT 2006

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY (RATES FOR WATER SUPPLY SERVICES)

(STATE OF KEDAH) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 84(2)(a) and 179(i) of the

Water Services Industry Act 2006 [Act 655], the Minister, on the recommendation of the

Commission, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Water Services Industry

(Rates for Water Supply Services) (State of Kedah) Regulations 2024.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 February 2024.

Rates for water supply services

2. The rates for water supply services for the state of Kedah shall be as prescribed

in the First Schedule.

Type of use

3. The type of use as specified in the First Schedule shall be as described in the

Second Schedule.

Revocation

4. The Water Services Industry (Rates for Water Supply Services) (State of Kedah)

Regulations 2010 [P.U. (A) 332/2010] is revoked.

Savings

5. Any action, notice, direction or decision made, done or given in relation to the rates

for the water supply services prescribed under the Water Services Industry

(Rates for Water Supply Services) (State of Kedah) Regulations 2010 before the coming

into operation of these Regulations shall continue to be valid and have effect until

amended or revoked or until the date of the expiry of such action, notice, direction

or decision.
